newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia stocks up, led by gas and banks.
newsitem.headline: Colombia stocks up, led by gas and banks.

text.p: Colombian stocks rose for the third consecutive session led by gas distribution and banks.

Bogota's IBB .IBB index edged up 0.3 percent to 1,205.57 amid a low 792 million peso volume while Medellin's IBOMED .IMBG general price index gained 0.51 percent to close at 18,386.53. Technical problems prevented the exchange from reporting total volumes traded.

One of the day's biggest gainers was the Atlantic coast gas distribution company Promigas, controlled by the Enron Corp. It closed up 2.56 percent at 4,800 in Bogota and up 1.07 percent to the same price in Medellin.
One Bogota dealer said demand for Promigas was being driven by its announcement that it would pay a one-off special share dividend for the five months to September.
Banco Ganadero, the country's largest bank in terms of assets, closed up 1.5 percent at 406 in Bogota and up 0.86 percent to the same price in Medellin.
Banco industrial Colombiano, gained 0.76 percent to 3,930 in both Bogota and Medellin.
The day's biggest fallers was brewing giant Bavaria, down 0.6 percent to 8,200.1 in Medellin and insurance company Suramericana de Seguros down 0.35 percent to 28,000 also in Medellin.
